item.tib: 'grel pa nyi ma'i snying po rgyal mo yang snying gsal byed kyi sgron ma
item.coloph: 'grel pa 'di yi brgyud tshul ni/ ye gshen gtsug phud/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ stag la me 'bar/ gong ma che drug gshen gdung rgyud bcu gsum/ stong rgyung mthu chen/ sha ri dbu chen/ gyim tsha rma chung / lce tsha mkhar bu/ gter srung dbal mo/ gter ston klu dga'/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ gshen sman rgod/ dam pa rgyal tshab/ dag bon sgom stag dag bon nyi rgyal/ dag dbon bon thung*/ dag bon lha tshul/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nas brgyud pa'o//
